They were correctly absent from the live Check B output re-run at the start of Phase 2, so the plan's own instruction to 'drive off its live Check B output rather than any hardcoded list' excludes them. check-runtime-file-tracking.sh exits 0 (all three checks pass), which is the task's stated definition of done. Deferred as out of scope for this task; a future task could extend the standard's pattern set to cover these variant suffixes if desired.
